description: Run the same prompt-to-config generation as create_voice_agent_from_prompt, but against an existing agent instead of creating a new one. Requires the OWNER or ADMIN role. On success the generated config is saved onto the agent immediately, overwriting its current name, personality, instructions, chat settings, and voice, speech-to-text, and LLM settings. If the prompt is too thin and manualInstructions was not sent, the response has needsFollowUp: true with a follow-up question instead — call this again with more detail.

agentId.description: ID of the existing voice agent to generate config for (from list_voice_agents)

manualInstructions.description: Requirements the generated instructions must include. Generation still runs; when this is sent, no follow-up question is returned even if the prompt is vague.

prompt.description: Plain-English description of what the agent should do.

name: generate_voice_agent_config

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API
